sentences.text: Heard the learned counsel for the petitioner and the learned HCGP for respondent No.1 - State.

Respondent No.2, who is served in the matter has remained unrepresented before this Court.
3. FIR in Crime No.270/2023 was registered by Chintamani Rural Police Station, Chickballapura,
against the petitioner and his parents for the aforesaid offences on the basis of the first NC:
2024:KHC:32912 information received from the victim girl, who was aged about 15 years.
During the course of investigation of the case, petitioner was arrested on 20.07.2023 and remanded to judicial custody.
Investigation in the case is completed and charge sheet has been filed against the petitioner and his parents for the aforesaid offences.
Petitioner is arraigned as accused No.1 in the charge sheet.
Bail application filed by the petitioner before the Trial Court in Crl.Misc.No.705/2023 was rejected on 29.11.2023.
Therefore, he is before this Court.

4. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the victim girl has not made any allegations against the petitioner either before the Doctor, who had medically examined her or before the Magistrate before whom her statement under Section 164 of Cr.P.C. was recorded.
The petitioner has no criminal antecedents and is in custody for more than one year.
Accordingly, he prays to allow the petition.
5. Per contra, learned HCGP has opposed the petition.
She submits that the victim is a minor girl aged about 15 years and therefore, the alleged offences clearly get attracted against the petitioner.

Sri. Venu vs State Of Karnataka on 14 August, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/35373946/
2
Accordingly, she prays to dismiss the petition.
FIR in the present case was registered on the basis of the statement given by the victim girl.

In the said statement, victim girl has stated that her marriage was performed with the petitioner in the presence of his parents and after her marriage, her grand mother came to her matrimonial house and brought her back.
Thereafter, she was taken by her grand mother before the Child Welfare Committee at Chickballapur and on 26.06.2023, she was brought to the police station and her statement was recorded.

Subsequent to registration of FIR on the basis of the aforesaid statement,
victim girl was produced before the Doctor for her medical examination on 28.06.2023.
Before the Doctor, the victim has not made any allegation of sexual assault committed by the petitioner during the period when the victim girl had stayed in his house.
The victim has not consented for her medical examination.
7. The statement of the victim girl under Section 164 of Cr.P.C. was recorded before the jurisdictional Magistrate subsequently.

In the said statement, victim girl has stated that she had gone to her aunt's house at Chandrahalli and when she was staying there, a false complaint has been filed alleging that her marriage was performed.

She has not made any allegation NC:
2024:KHC:32912 against the petitioner in her statement recorded under Section 164 of Cr.P.C.
Investigation in the case is complete and charge sheet has been filed.
Petitioner is aged about 23 years and is in custody from 20.07.2023.
Allegation against the petitioner is required to be proved in a full fledged trial.
Accused Nos.2 and 3 have already been enlarged on bail.
Under the circumstances, I am of the opinion that petitioner's prayer for grant of regular bail is required to be answered affirmatively.
Accordingly, the following order:-
8. The petition is allowed.
The petitioner is directed to be enlarged on bail in Spl.S.C.No.107/2023 pending before the Court of Addl.
